name: AP World History
tagline: One kit per unit, built from AMSCO. Pick a unit to study; progress in each one is saved in this browser.

units.label: Unit 2
units.title: Networks of Exchange
units.blurb: 1200 to 1450: the Silk Roads, the Mongol Empire, the Indian Ocean, trans-Saharan trade, and the cultural and environmental effects of exchange (AMSCO 2.1 to 2.7).

units.label: Unit 3
units.title: Land-Based Empires
units.blurb: 1450 to 1750: the Ottoman, Safavid, Mughal, Qing and Russian empires, Songhai and Tokugawa Japan; how they expanded, ruled, paid for themselves and handled religion (AMSCO 3.1 to 3.4).
